marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 進春府敘事， 1921-2022年 | Jin Chun Fu Xu Shi. 1921-2022 Nian

This is a field report based on oral history, synthesizing the interviews of several personalities to reconstruct their historical memories of the temple in Chin Chun Foo, as well as the meetings of their religious life in the disappeared “Hokkien Village” in Kuala Lumpur, where they lived in the last century. The overall content of this book describes how a temple, from scratch, originated in the local social life of a village, and how it was integrated into the public life of the villagers, and how it continues to carry traditional cultural elements and values through the propagation of beliefs and customs. The history of Jinchunfu provides a typical example of the origins and evolution of fair temple rituals and beliefs in the villages and towns of Southern Fujian in the Nanyang region.
